input_latch.doc: Camera-relative input keeps the pre-change camera's reference across a shot change until the stick is released (genre convention for fixed cameras). release_on_turn_deg > 0 also releases the latch when the stick turns more than that from its direction at the change.

shore.doc: FieldShore (the human's playtest: on Oruvel's dock town you could step off a deck and walk in the sea). Over ground under a zone WaterSurface by more than wade_m, a step is refused (he stays at the edge, as at a wall) when the ground drops more than edge_drop_m from where he stood (a dock, pier or hull edge), or lies more than deep_water_m under the surface and deeper than where he stood (walking back out is always allowed). Grounded deeper than deep_water_m anyway, he is put back on his last safe spot. Standing more than underwater_m under the surface, he walks the seabed (Oruvel's underway): no shore rule. The ground is found by a ray from probe_up_m above to probe_down_m below; a spot where the ray finds no ground is not judged (a ray that starts inside a terrain collider misses it).
